question: Hornbill and Moatsu Festivals are predominantly celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nagaland.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Hornbill Festival and the Moatsu Festival **are two of the most significant cultural festivals of Nagaland.
 
• **Hornbill festival **is celebrated **annually from December 1st to December 10th**.
 
• It was started by **Government of Nagaland in 2000 **and named on **Hornbill bird.**
